overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law when two members discussed a pending police cruiser matter outside a posted meeting; no intent finding was made, and compliance was ordered.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a quorum of the Board deliberated outside a properly posted meeting about a police cruiser before its January 9 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law when two Board members discussed the police cruiser, a matter within the Board’s jurisdiction, outside of the January 9 meeting.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law ordered; similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent.
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
